name: Dallas
commonIssues: Dallas properties face frequent thunderstorms, hail, and flash flooding that drive water damage emergencies. The North Texas climate combines high humidity with hot summers, creating ideal conditions for mold growth in attics and crawlspaces. Aging infrastructure in older neighborhoods like Oak Cliff and East Dallas often leads to sewer backups and pipe failures.

name: Plano
commonIssues: Plano's rapid growth means many homes are 20-40 years old with original plumbing nearing end-of-life. Severe spring storms bring hail and wind damage to roofs, which leads to water intrusion. North Texas humidity drives bathroom and laundry-room mold issues.

name: Frisco
commonIssues: Many Frisco homes were built in the 2000s with builder-grade materials. Hail and wind damage from spring thunderstorms is a constant concern. Foundation movement from expansive clay soil often causes plumbing leaks behind walls.

name: McKinney
commonIssues: Historic Downtown McKinney has many century-old buildings with original wiring and plumbing that require careful restoration. Newer subdivisions face hail damage and foundation-related plumbing leaks from clay soil shifts.

name: Allen
commonIssues: Allen experiences frequent hail storms that damage roofs and trigger interior water damage. Many homes from the 1990s-2000s have aging water heaters and HVAC condensate lines that fail and cause leaks.

name: Irving
commonIssues: Irving's mix of older neighborhoods and Las Colinas high-rises creates varied restoration needs. The Trinity River corridor brings flood risk, and DFW Airport-area commercial buildings need rapid response to minimize business disruption.

name: Garland
commonIssues: Many Garland homes built in the 1960s-80s have cast iron sewer lines that have corroded, leading to sewage backups. Lake Ray Hubbard area properties face occasional flood damage during heavy rains.

name: Mesquite
commonIssues: Mesquite's older housing stock means aging plumbing, original HVAC systems, and outdated electrical that contribute to water and fire damage emergencies. Severe weather brings hail and wind damage seasonally.

name: Carrollton
commonIssues: Carrollton properties experience the typical North Texas hail and wind damage from spring storms. Older homes in the original Carrollton area have aging foundations and plumbing prone to leaks.

name: Richardson
commonIssues: Richardson's mid-century homes have original galvanized plumbing prone to failure. The Telecom Corridor's commercial buildings need fast restoration response to keep tenants operational. Hail damage is frequent during spring storm season.
